provider: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only identity for the official Berlin ALKIS building and building-part WFS. This contract does not authorize sending either operation. A future provider-specific worker must freeze WFS version, exact GetCapabilities parameters, feature type(s) from the original capabilities/schema, a predeclared 200m x 200m EPSG:25833 Berlin research bounding box, response CRS, page/feature cap, content-type and byte limit; reject any caller-selected host, arbitrary query, redirects, unbounded feature traversal or whole-Berlin extraction. The existing five-feature source receipt does not turn this generic interface into an executable access contract.

response_contract.format: Official ALKIS Berlin Gebäude WFS service capabilities and building/building-part vector features; authoritative service metadata indicate OGC WFS 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 2.0.0, CRS EPSG:25833.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Official mutable cadastral building and building-part geometry; updated monthly. An individual ALKIS feature may represent a building or building part rather than one insured asset. Original EPSG:25833 feature identity, date/vintage, geometry type and provenance must survive ingestion. Do not infer building age, insured location, replacement value, TIV, construction type or hazard vulnerability. A separately produced 2022 LoD2 building-height layer derives from ALKIS footprints and height surfaces and is not geometrically independent of this WFS. Historical 2021 building stock cannot be inferred from a current 2026 feature alone.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: The official Berlin Geoportal identifies anonymous web feature access but no approved automated request rate or bulk-download quota was established in this contract. No new request is enabled by this documentation; future operations require a bounded site-specific worker and current official service terms review.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Provider describes monthly ALKIS updates; catalogue metadata show 2026 publication/update dates. Bind every later source read to exact UTC retrieval time, service response SHA-256, feature schema/CRS, requested bbox and dataset vintage; never silently substitute current geometry for the 2021 stock or 2022 LoD2 baseline.

rights_and_policy.notes: The official Berlin Open Data catalogue and government spatial metadata identify Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0 for the ALKIS buildings layer, without access restrictions. This validates the published layer license, not a numeric provider automation quota, personal-attribute reuse, independent model-input science or all possible derivative publications. Separate WFS service/request conditions have not been reviewed; status therefore remains documented_only and execution disabled.

notes: New contract documents a previously inventoried Berlin source and the official endpoint. This is not a network probe or original feature retrieval. Prior five-feature work is independent evidence recorded elsewhere in the repo; do not promote its science or rights status by implication. No new CAT4 data, insured values, building identities or model inputs are admitted here.
